value_stream.name: HR Shared Services, Employee Experience & People Analytics

fields.Participants: EX Manager, HRSS (W3335), Hiring Manager, IT (links to VS-27/VS-99), Training (links to VS-19.4), Buddy/Mentor

workflows.name: Employee Onboarding Experience & Day-1 Readiness Program

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "EX Manager design/operate the onboarding experience" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assignment, and store/DC orientation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "measure onboarding effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: structured experience and feedback; operational: pre-boarding checklist (W3335)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Early-attrition risk**: Poor onboarding loses hires in first 90 days; mitigated by structured experience and feedback
- **Readiness-gap risk**: Day-1 without access/equipment harms experience; mitigated by pre-boarding checklist (W3335)
System Touchpoints: - Onboarding platform; HRSS (W3335); training (links to VS-19.4); IT/equipment (links to VS-99)

steps.activity: EX Manager design/operate the onboarding experience: pre-boarding (welcome pack, e-sign documents links to W3333, system access links to W3335), day-1 readiness (workspace, equipment, uniform, introductions), and first-week program

Hiring Manager/EX Manager deliver role onboarding: team integration, expectations, goals (30/60/90), training (POS/safety/product per VS-19.4), buddy assignment, and store/DC orientation; collect early feedback
EX Manager measure onboarding effectiveness (time-to-productivity, 30/60/90 feedback, early retention links to VS-103.3) and continuously improve the program

fields.Participants: EX Manager, People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), Managers, Comms (links to VS-103.2), CHRO

workflows.name: Employee Engagement Pulse, Survey Operations & Action Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze results by segment" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track progress, communicate" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: cadence and visible action; operational: mobile access and manager advocacy
Pain Points / Risks: - **Survey-fatigue risk**: Over-surveying without action erodes trust; mitigated by cadence and visible action
- **Low-response risk**: Store/DC low participation skews results; mitigated by mobile access and manager advocacy
System Touchpoints: - Survey platform; people analytics (links to VS-103.3); comms (links to VS-103.2); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: EX Manager/People Analytics design and run engagement surveys (annual) and pulses (quarterly): items (engagement drivers, enablement, manager effectiveness, wellbeing), confidentiality, and channel (mobile-friendly for store staff)

People Analytics analyze results by segment (store/DC/HQ, tenure, entity), identify drivers and hotspots, and share team-level results with managers for action planning; coordinate with labor-relations engagement (links to VS-84.3 W2889)
Managers/EX Manager build and execute action plans, track progress, communicate "you said / we did" (links to VS-103.2), and measure engagement movement over time (links to VS-103.3)

fields.Participants: Internal Comms Mgr, EX (links to VS-103.2), Store Comms (links to VS-63), Marketing (links to VS-14.3), Leadership

workflows.name: Internal Communications, Intranet & Company-Wide Broadcast Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with marketing brand" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "measure reach/engagement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: segmentation and prioritization; operational: multi-channel and store-comms integration (links to VS-63)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Information-overload risk**: Noise drowns key messages; mitigated by segmentation and prioritization
- **Store-reach risk**: Store/DC staff miss key messages; mitigated by multi-channel and store-comms integration (links to VS-63)
System Touchpoints: - Intranet/IC platform; store comms (links to VS-63); mobile app (links to VS-75); comms analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Internal Comms Mgr operate the intranet and comms channels (email, mobile app links to VS-75, store communication links to VS-63, digital signage, bulletin boards for stores): content publishing, segmentation by audience (store/DC/HQ/entity), and scheduling

Internal Comms Mgr/Leadership craft company-wide broadcasts (strategy, results, policy, recognition, change) with clear, consistent messaging; coordinate with marketing brand (links to VS-14.3) and store task management (links to VS-63) for store reach

Internal Comms Mgr measure reach/engagement (open rates, read receipts, feedback), optimize channel mix, and ensure two-way flow (links to W3342 feedback); manage crisis-comms coordination (links to VS-14.3 W134/W1562)

fields.Participants: Internal Comms Mgr, Leadership, EX, IT/AV (links to VS-27), Facilities (links to VS-07.2)

workflows.name: Town Hall, Leadership Communication & All-Hands Event Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logistics, and AV/IT" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with labor-relations forums" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "recordings/summaries, track attendance/reach, measure sentiment impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: livestream and rotation; operational: Q&A and follow-up
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reach-equity risk**: Provincial stores/DCs feel excluded; mitigated by livestream and rotation
- **Top-down-only risk**: One-way town halls erode trust; mitigated by Q&A and follow-up
System Touchpoints: - AV/streaming (links to VS-27); store comms (links to VS-63); intranet (links to VS-103.2); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Internal Comms Mgr/Leadership plan town halls and all-hands: agenda (performance links to VS-33.2, strategy, recognition, Q&A), format (in-person HQ + livestream to 200 stores/DCs), logistics, and AV/IT (links to VS-27)

Leadership deliver town halls with authentic two-way communication, live Q&A, and recognition; capture questions/feedback for follow-up (links to W3342) and coordinate with labor-relations forums (links to VS-84.3 W2890)
Internal Comms Mgr publish recordings/summaries, track attendance/reach, measure sentiment impact (links to W3338), and improve format

fields.Participants: EX Manager, Employees, Managers, Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Comms (links to VS-103.2)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "EX Manager operate the peer-to-peer recognition platform" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track participation/equity, measure engagement impact" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: equity monitoring and store inclusion; operational: values-linkage and guidelines
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inequity risk**: Recognition concentrated in HQ/visible roles; mitigated by equity monitoring and store inclusion
- **Dilution risk**: Low-value recognition erodes meaning; mitigated by values-linkage and guidelines
System Touchpoints: - Recognition platform; payroll/awards (links to VS-19.2/VS-102.3); comms (links to VS-103.2); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: EX Manager operate the peer-to-peer recognition platform: enable employees to send recognition/points tied to values, integrate with monetary awards (links to VS-102.3 W3326), and manage budgets/redemption catalog
EX Manager/Comms promote a culture of recognition, celebrate wins publicly (intranet links to VS-103.2, store comms links to VS-63), and ensure equity across roles/locations (store staff inclusion)
EX Manager track participation/equity, measure engagement impact (links to W3338), and report recognition reach and ROI (links to VS-102.3 W3328)

fields.Participants: EX Manager, Employees, Managers, Process Excellence (links to W3352)

workflows.name: Employee Feedback Loop, Suggestion & Idea Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-route of "route to owners" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track implementation rate and impact, and feed trends to leadership" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: closed-loop communication; operational: categorization and thresholds
Pain Points / Risks: - **Black-hole risk**: Suggestions with no response erode trust; mitigated by closed-loop communication
- **Volume risk**: Too many low-value ideas overwhelm triage; mitigated by categorization and thresholds
System Touchpoints: - Idea-management platform; innovation (links to VS-30); store ops (links to VS-07); comms (links to VS-103.2)

steps.activity: EX Manager operate the suggestion/idea channel (portal, app, in-store kiosks): capture ideas (process improvement, customer experience, cost saving), categorize, and route to owners
EX Manager/owners triage and evaluate ideas for feasibility/impact, implement where valuable (links to VS-30 innovation, VS-07 store ops), and recognize contributors (links to VS-102.3 W3326/W3341)
EX Manager close the loop: communicate outcomes ("you said / we did" links to VS-103.2), track implementation rate and impact, and feed trends to leadership (links to VS-33.2)

EX Manager operate DEI programs: training, events, inclusive-policy review (hiring, benefits, facilities), and bias-mitigation in talent processes; coordinate with pay-equity remediation (links to VS-102 W3309)

People Analytics/EX Manager measure DEI outcomes (workforce composition links to W3348, hiring/promotion equity, pay equity links to W3309, engagement by demographic, accessibility), report to CHRO/board (links to VS-36/VS-25.2), and adjust programs

workflows.name: Employee Value Proposition, Culture & EX Measurement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure EX across the journey" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report EX health to leadership" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-539 (ensure controlled execution — Employee Experience, Engagement & Internal Communications (PA-103.2).)
- operational: EX measurement and action; operational: journey-based metrics
Pain Points / Risks: - **EVP-reality gap risk**: Promised EVP doesn't match experience; mitigated by EX measurement and action
- **Measurement-blindness risk**: No EX data to prioritize; mitigated by journey-based metrics
System Touchpoints: - EX/analytics platform (links to VS-28.1); engagement (W3338); rewards (links to VS-102); people analytics (links to VS-103.3)

steps.activity: EX Manager/CHRO define and maintain the Employee Value Proposition (EVP): rewards (links to VS-102), development (links to VS-19.4), purpose, work environment, leadership, and culture pillars; align to employer brand (links to VS-14.3)

EX Manager measure EX across the journey (onboard W3337, daily work, development, recognition, lifecycle events) via EX metrics (journey CSAT, eNPS, moments-that-matter), and correlate to engagement (W3338) and retention (links to VS-103.3)
EX Manager/CHRO use EX insight to prioritize investments (rewards, tools, managers), report EX health to leadership (links to VS-33.2), and refresh EVP/culture strategy
